fib: ______ are a combination of primary and secondary tools subject to the caution that scant reliance should be placed on secondary tools in order to draw a conclusion of law.
The tools used are a combination of primary and secondary tools subject to the caution that scant reliance should be placed on secondary tools in order to draw a conclusion of law.
______ is the Act passed by the National Assembly or Law passed by a House of Assembly of a State.
A primary legislation is the Act passed by the National Assembly or Law passed by a House of Assembly of a State.
______ is the primary laboratory of legal research.
The law library is the primary laboratory of legal research.
______ are the description of the methodology, the findings and acknowledgment of sources (bibliography) including recommendations.
The important elements are the description of the methodology, the findings and acknowledgment of sources (bibliography) including recommendations.
______ is the formal acknowledgment and identification of data opinions and various other materials that have contributed to the overall quality of the research.
Documentation is the formal acknowledgment and identification of data opinions and various other materials that have contributed to the overall quality of the research.
______ refers to the body of laws itself i.e. the Constitution, Acts, Laws, and case reports.
A primary source refers to the body of laws itself i.e. the Constitution, Acts, Laws, and case reports.
